hints.title: Prerequisite Dependency Order
hints.text: Each course can start only after all its direct prerequisites have concluded.

hints.title: Dynamic Programming on DAG
hints.text: The earliest completion time of a course is its own duration plus the maximum completion time among its prerequisites.

hints.title: Topological Evaluation
hints.text: Process courses in dependency order to determine the global maximum completion time.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(V + E) topological processing of DAG
complexity.space: O(V + E) adjacency lists and in-degree table
complexity.notes: Earliest course completion equals course duration plus max prerequisite completion.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy scheduling without prerequisite topological order misses longest dependency chains.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Kahn algorithm in-degree queue updates longest path distances in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should formulate this as finding the longest path in a DAG.
